gen-gf-poly-fs-bespoke-sans: Literary in mood, Poly lets its joins taper just enough that you feel the shift more than see it. Bespoke Sans sits beside it sharp and refined, with generous gaps where curves meet stems.
gen-gf-pontano-sans-fs-literata: Literata arrives bookish and sophisticated, its text serif strokes slightly heavier on the thick parts, under Pontano Sans with its wide-mouthed modern letters. Both stay open.
gen-gf-prata-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans keeps its curves loose and sharp. Prata above it swings between fat downstrokes and wispy upstrokes, so the sans gives the eye somewhere quiet to land.
gen-gf-prosto-one-bitter: Bitter's slab-serif lowercase is huge in the eye, with s shapes you can see straight through. Prosto One stands over it, tall and wide-striding.
gen-gf-prosto-one-instrument-sans: Prosto One stretches its tall lowercase wide across the line. It handles swelling bowls from hairline to stem, while Instrument Sans simply draws every stroke at a single width, minimal and modern.
gen-gf-prosto-one-inter: Prosto One stands tall, its lowercase all height and its bowls gently shifting in weight. Inter follows in a smooth, tube-like sans-serif, earning its place where Prosto One's big, short lines would otherwise tire.
gen-gf-prosto-one-poppins: Commanding from the first letter, Prosto One strides wide with tall bodies and gently modulated bowls, no sharp hairlines anywhere. Poppins' sans-serif lines stay constant beneath, so Prosto One is best big and brief.
gen-gf-prosto-one-roboto-slab: Roboto Slab is precise and structured. Under Prosto One's tall, wide-striding display letters, its slab-serif middle zone dominates each line and its open throats keep a long passage moving smoothly.
gen-gf-prosto-one-rubik: Prosto One brings tall lowercase and a wide stride, its stems only a shade heavier than the arms joining them. And Rubik's soft sans, with big lowercase and open round shapes, keeps a long stretch of text easy going.
gen-gf-proza-libre-fs-literata: Plain, contemporary and clean, Proza Libre makes the heading. Literata's text serif follows with a smooth, modest weight gradient, so a long passage feels bookish and sophisticated without ever getting fussy.
